original.dtype_rule: fit on float64 daily rows; transform ((x-mean)/scale).astype(np.float32)

methods.source_partial_rule: linear interpolation between clean and raw-zero fully ablated standardized tensors; manuscript Section III-K
methods.source_full_rule: inverse scale using development-only frozen scaler, zero source count/presence, recompute total and activity and zero duration only if inactive, rescale
methods.noise_rule: authoritative gaussian_noise_continuous with SHA-derived paired RNG per level; continuous indices 0:7; bounded elementwise relative noise with floor zero; binary indices 7:13 unchanged; severity zero reuses clean saved scores
methods.AURC: trapezoidal integral of AP(severity)/AP(clean), divided by maximum severity; source aggregate is arithmetic mean over five source AURCs

operational.delay: first positive-window alert end-date minus first malicious day in allowed TRAIN+VALIDATION; no TEST first-day lookup
operational.episodes: consecutive or same alert decision days per user; malicious-day containment uses actual daily labels
operational.top_k_label: endpoint malicious day primary; completed-window label also reported
operational.unobserved_days: first 19 days of each period not scorable and marked unavailable

ranking.budget_count: ceil(N*budget); stable score-descending row order for ties
ranking.FPR_rule: largest attainable ROC TPR at or below specified FPR, without target threshold recalibration

calibration.TRACE: one common positive temperature fitted once on pooled three-seed DEVELOPMENT VALIDATION logits; shared unchanged across seeds
calibration.XGBoost_40: one common unpenalized Platt logistic map fitted once on pooled three-seed DEVELOPMENT VALIDATION logit scores; shared unchanged across seeds
calibration.temperature_parameterization: log T; numerical bounds [-10,10] for stable scalar NLL minimization

Holm.p_values: two-sided bootstrap sign-tail probability with add-one correction: 2*min((1+n(delta<=0))/(B+1),(1+n(delta>=0))/(B+1)), capped at 1; exploratory approximate p-values

methods.power: normal approximation from observed paired bootstrap CI width; report 95% half-width and two-sided alpha .05 80%-power MDE; not a guarantee
methods.resources: two CPU threads; at most 35% per-process GPU memory; 1 ms cooperative pause per neural batch; no other processes managed
methods.incident_bootstrap: historical harness defines user bootstrap and notes 1:1 official insider/incident correspondence, not an independent incident-only bootstrap
methods.transfer_scalers: Original block uses stored r5.2-all-user TRAIN z-space directly. Development block uses its own frozen DEVELOPMENT TRAIN scaler via float64 inverse of stored original z-space and forward transform; no target fitting. Float32 source-bundle quantization is retained and disclosed.
methods.r61_provenance: Historical input-manifest hash verified; r6.1 derived bundle has no historical byte hashes in EDITOR024 SHA manifest, so its current bytes are hashed and frozen before feature-only analysis.
